e.title: OpenDRR RiskProfiler
e.summary: 加拿大抗灾韧性 Web 应用（OpenDRR）：灾害风险画像与韧性支持
e.body: RiskProfiler 是 OpenDRR（加拿大灾害风险降低平台）的 Web 应用：支持灾害韧性（disaster resilience）——灾害风险画像（地震/洪水等）与韧性评估。对 RIAA：灾害风险画像的官方平台参考（多灾害风险暴露）。与 [[openquake-engine]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[catia]]、[[databricks-flood-prediction]] 互补。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：OpenDRR 抗灾韧性 Web 应用（灾害风险画像）
e.summary_en: Canadian disaster-resilience Web application (OpenDRR): hazard risk profiling and resilience support
e.summary_hk: 加拿大抗災韌性 Web 應用（OpenDRR）：災害風險畫像與韌性支持
e.body_en: RiskProfiler is the OpenDRR (Canadian disaster-risk-reduction platform) Web application supporting disaster resilience: hazard risk profiling (earthquake/flood etc.) and resilience assessment. For RIAA: the official platform reference for hazard risk profiling (multi-hazard risk exposure). Complements [[openquake-engine]], [[canada-seismic-risk-model]], [[catia]] and [[databricks-flood-prediction]]. Related: [[reinsurance]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: RiskProfiler 是 OpenDRR（加拿大災害風險降低平台）的 Web 應用：支持災害韌性（disaster resilience）——災害風險畫像（地震/洪水等）與韌性評估。對 RIAA：災害風險畫像的官方平台參考（多災害風險暴露）。與 [[openquake-engine]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[catia]]、[[databricks-flood-prediction]] 互補。關聯 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
